title: Anthropic · 博客来源更新
summary: 博客新增了关于Enterprise Frontier Safeguards和Long-Term Benefit Trust新成员的文章，删除了旧文章，内容更新。

added_lines: Dr. Christopher Stubbs, an experimental physicist and former Dean of Science at Harvard University, has joined Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust. He brings to the Trust decades of scientific expertise across observational cosmology and precision measurement.
Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust

We’re announcing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS), a solution that combines the privacy of zero data retention with state-of-the-art safeguards for detecting misuse. EFS works by storing data in cloud infrastructure controlled by the customer, not Anthropic.
